name: Radiography of Emissive Objects via HAVS
definition: A volume rendering technique for emissive objects that solves the full transport equation (Eq. 5) using back-to-front compositing. It extends the HAVS algorithm to handle piecewise constant extinction coefficients and source terms for multiple energy groups, computing the transport equation in the fragment program rather than using a pre-computed lookup table.
summary: Radiography of Emissive Objects via HAVS extends Hardware-Assisted Visibility Sorting to solve the full radiative transport equation in the fragment shader, avoiding lookup table errors for emissive objects.
